link_text: CODE OF ORDINANCES GREEN OAK CHARTER TOWNSHIP, MICHIGAN

Ordinance No. 03-2026 Adopted 6/17/26 AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND CHAPTER 2, "ADMINISTRATION," ARTICLE III, "OFFICERS AND EMPLOYEES," TO ADD A NEW DIVISION 3, ENTITLED "BARGAINING UNIT NEGOTIATOR" TO ESTABLISH THE POSITION OF CONTRACTED BARGAINING UNIT NEGOTIATOR DIRECTOR; TO PROVIDE FOR APPOINTMENT, DUTIES, AUTHORITY, SUPERVISION, AND REMOVAL; AND TO PROVIDE FOR RELATED MATTERS PURSUANT TO THE AUTHORITY GRANTED TO TOWNSHIPS UNDER THE LAWS OF THE STATE OF MICHIGAN.
